name: Deepfake coercion to UPI mule cash-out
attack_summary: A victim is coerced during a deepfake call into authorizing a genuine UPI transfer from their usual device to a fraud-controlled mule. The payment credentials look legitimate, so detection must combine beneficiary behavior, money-flow topology, and durable signs of coercion on the payer side.

param_semantics.n_victims: Number of customers coerced in the simulated campaign. More victims increase yield and exposure but require more concurrent social-engineering operations.
param_semantics.mule_age_days: How long receiving accounts existed before use. Older accounts look less disposable, but pre-aged accounts cost more and risk being frozen before use.
param_semantics.split_factor: Number of accounts across which funds are divided at a laundering hop. Wider splitting lowers per-account fan-in but needs more mules and operational coordination.
param_semantics.dwell_time_hours: How long funds remain in a mule account before moving. Longer dwell looks less like instant laundering but increases exposure to freezes and victim reports.
param_semantics.amount_multiplier_vs_baseline: Coerced payment size relative to the victim's historical mean. Higher values improve criminal yield but are more anomalous for the payer.
param_semantics.n_cashout_points: Number of final withdrawal destinations. More destinations reduce convergence but require expensive cash-out infrastructure.
param_semantics.n_mules_layer1: Number of first-hop receiving accounts. More accounts spread victim payments but increase acquisition and management cost.

defender_signals.a1_benef_account_age_days: Age in days of the account receiving the transfer.
defender_signals.a1_benef_fanin_24h: Number of distinct prior payers sending to the beneficiary during the preceding 24 hours.
defender_signals.a1_dissipation_ratio: Share of received value that leaves the beneficiary within one hour.
defender_signals.a1_payer_amount_zscore: Payment amount relative to the payer's prior spending distribution.
defender_signals.a1_payee_added_to_transfer_seconds: Elapsed seconds between adding the beneficiary and initiating the transfer.
defender_signals.a1_component_size: Number of accounts in the beneficiary's two-hop transfer neighborhood.
defender_signals.a1_component_dissipation: External outflow divided by external inflow for the beneficiary's transfer component.
defender_signals.a1_cashout_convergence: Number of distinct upstream mule paths converging on shared cash-out infrastructure.
defender_signals.a1_component_age_variance: Variance of account ages inside the beneficiary's transfer component.
defender_signals.a1_call_active: Whether a phone call was active while the payment was initiated.
defender_signals.a1_session_duration_anomaly: Deviation of the current payment-session duration from the payer's prior behavior.
